claims.text: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on 20 July 1969.
Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon.
Buzz Aldrin was the second person to walk on the Moon.
Michael Collins remained in lunar orbit while Armstrong and Aldrin landed.

lies.text: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on 20 July 1972.
Neil Armstrong was the second person to walk on the Moon.

adds.text: Apollo 11 was the fifth crewed mission of NASA's Apollo program.
